## Use Lotion in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Lotion for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Lotion', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

Lotion is available from Official Website.

## About the Lotion coding font

A paid font designed for developers. Lotion is a paid monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Lotion is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Lotion FAQ

### Is Lotion free?

No. Lotion is a commercial font, sold by its vendor.

### Does Lotion support ligatures?

No. Lotion has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Lotion?

Lotion is available from Official Website. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
